# Bottle

## Work
- **Title:** Bottle
- **Artist / Maker:** Roman; Syria or Palestine
- **Date:** 1st century
- **Style / Period:** roman (ancient, style or period)
- **Classification:** bottle
- **Department:** Arts of Greece, Rome, and Byzantium
- **AIC artwork ID:** 532
